explanation: Liverpool-born journalist Arthur Wynne created it for the New York World of 21 December 1913. He called it a 'word-cross', and the first grid was shaped like a diamond.

claims.text: The first crossword puzzle was published in the New York World newspaper in 1913.
The first crossword was not published in London, Liverpool or Boston.
Arthur Wynne, born in Liverpool, created the first crossword for the New York World of 21 December 1913.
Wynne's first crossword grid was diamond-shaped.
